clauses: Use the mean of all nonmissing budget-line amounts as the overall average.
Use the unweighted mean of event averages as the overall average.
readings: Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first. Use the mean of all nonmissing budget-line amounts as the overall average.

Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first. Use the unweighted mean of event averages as the overall average.
queries:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT
        ea.link_to_event,
        ea.average_amount,
        ea.average_amount - (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget) AS above_overall_average
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    WHERE ea.average_amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget)
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    average_amount,
    above_overall_average,
    average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average) AS gap_from_above_average_mean
FROM above_average
ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS amount FROM event_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event,
           ea.average_amount,
           ea.average_amount - oa.amount AS above_overall
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.average_amount > oa.amount
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       average_amount,
       above_overall,
       average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average) AS above_average_gap
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_average_gap DESC
LIMIT 10
